description: Save a policy for one school from a person's answers. Give unitid, name (the person who answered) and policy: award_rules, each an award_title with its min_credits and other conditions; designations, each a designation with its credits and the course codes that carry it; and notes. No quote is asked for or checked. Each award title must be one of the school's, each minimum a positive number (or left out where the server can infer one), and each course code one of the school's learning units; answers that fail a check come back with each error and nothing is saved. The policy's source is survey, with the person's name, its built_by is survey: <name>, and its trust state is unverified. It never replaces a policy in use that was built from the school's own pages: it then refuses, says so, and points to a rebuild.

name.description: The name of the person whose answers these are

policy.description: award_rules: [{ award_title, min_credits, other }]; designations: [{ designation, credits, courses }]; notes: [text]

unitid.description: The school, by its IPEDS UNITID
